**OMERO-suite credentials system**
The present OMERO-tool use a powerful credential system implemented in Galaxy 25.1 that enables tools to securely access external APIs and services through encrypted secret storage.
To learn more about how credentials are stored in Galaxy, please read the [Secure Vaut Storage post](https://artifact.galaxyproject.org/news/2026-01-12-tool-credentials-system/]).
